name: Epic Fury of the Flame
upgradeable: Legendary Crafting to Legendary Fury of the Flame

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus : +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Impact
effects.tooltip: Impact : Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification .

effects.name: Flaming Blast
effects.tooltip: Flaming Blast 4 : This weapon burns with deadly magical fire, dealing 4d6 Fire damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Fire damage on a critical hit.

effects.name: Coruscating
effects.tooltip: Coruscating 4 : This effect causes the edges of this weapon to coruscate, dealing 4d6 Light damage on each hit.

effects.name: Fracturing
effects.tooltip: Fracturing 4 : This weapon is ideal for breaking bones and does 4d8 damage to targets that have skeletons or are made of bone.

effects.name: Adamantine
effects.tooltip: Adamantine : Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.

flavor_text: A mighty weapon forged by request of the Silver Flame templars and imbued with the fiery wrath of the Silver Flame itself. It metes out judgement in the form of blinding light, burns, and broken bones.
tips: Seal drops in Servants of the Overlord, shard drops in The Spinner of Shadows

source.raw: Epic version of Fury of the Flame
